## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Agrigento, Italy. It starts at Contrada San Nicola 12.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> You can explore a vast array of ancient artifacts at the Archaeological Museum Pietro Griffo. You'll see artifacts from Greek, Roman, and Byzantine periods, including ancient sculptures, detailed mosaics, and pottery.
>
> Exhibits showcase the grandeur of the nearby Valley of the Temples, with clear explanations to help you understand each piece's significance. Don't miss the coin collection that offers a glimpse into the economic life of ancient times. Beyond just viewing relics, you'll experience the rich history that shaped this region and leave with a deeper appreciation for the ancient world.
>
> Use this ticket to enter the Regional Archaeological Museum Pietro Griffo, and see ancient statues of the gods, and famous mythical heroes, as well as everyday items like coins, vases, masks, pottery, and more.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €14.69. It was rated 3.5 out of 5 from 2 ratings and 1 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
